title: The Fragments of Sappho
author: Sappho of Lesbos
edition_reference: Public-domain critical editions (Wharton 1885, Edmonds 1922, Cox 1924). Voigt is under copyright and not admitted.
provenance_note: Sappho's surviving lyric fragments. Only PD critical editions enter the canon; modern reconstructions and translations under copyright are excluded per the canon's copyright discipline.
constitutional_role: Foundational Greek lyric. The text most closely engaged in the Crimson Hexagonal corpus's worked examples (Shadow-Sappho 31; the Sappho 31 / Catullus 51 alignment). A primary text of the descent into desire and loss.
status: STUB — fragments not yet populated. Sappho 31 is a v1 priority for inclusion.
